name: Sienna Lake
source: A former porn actress who now manages actresses in the industry. She approaches the [url=/c169868]Protagonist[/url] in the cafe where she works and presents her with an opportunity. At the height of her career, she was very close with [url=/c169887]Lorna[/url], who died young.
